---
name: Feature request
about: Propose new capability or a change in behavior
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**Problem**
What can't you do today, and why does it matter? (Concrete use case, not just
"it would be nice.")

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see — a new CLI flag, a new `PipelineConfig` field, a new
port implementation, etc.

**Alternatives considered**
Any workarounds you're using today, and why they fall short.

**Related backlog items**
Check `.claude/tasks/INDEX.md` — this may already be a planned ticket
(open one if it names a related, unimplemented item).
